fact: In the National Assembly's budget debate of 14 November 2023 the Member for Chembe said that security offices mostly have no stationery, that case docket covers 'are no longer there', which is why evidence is at times lost, and that officers therefore take classified forms, the Zambia Police Service's ZP Form 32 among them, to Internet cafés to be photocopied, and asked that stationery be given to officers in urban and rural areas alike.
title: Debates - Tuesday, 14th November, 2023
